title: Confined sessions run ssh and read only the project's declared sibling repositories
description: Under real bubblewrap, with a fixture HOME whose code/da holds a project beside two sibling checkouts: ssh -G localhost exits 0 instead of reporting bad owner or permissions on the system ssh include directory; the sibling the repository lists in graphyard.json confinement.readonlyPaths is readable and not writable; an unlisted sibling stays unreadable; and the project's own checkout stays readable.
